typography.guidelines: Do not use Space Grotesk, Inter, or Roboto. Use Clash Display for large impact headings and Satoshi for legible, clean body text. Headings should have tight letter spacing.

colors.guidelines: No purple or violet gradients. Stick strictly to this warm, aspirational, organic palette. Use Deep Indigo for CTAs and Marigold for highlights/accents.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Avoid cramped UI.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Use asymmetrical 'bento' layouts for the consumer marketplace. Use strict 3-col 'control room' grid for merchant dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-2xl for primary cards and images, rounded-full for buttons and badges.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-[#E5E2DC]) on merchant dashboard cards for crisp definition without shadows.

consumer.header: Sticky glassmorphic header (z-50) featuring a Hyperlocal Location Selector (Blinkit style).
consumer.hero_carousel: Full-width or rounded edge carousel showcasing high-quality lifestyle fashion images. Include subtle noise texture over solids.
consumer.store_card: Instagram-boutique feel. 4:5 aspect ratio images. Overlay rating, distance (e.g., '1.2 km away'), and store name at the bottom. Minimal UI, high visual impact.
consumer.pdp: Immersive image gallery. 'AI Enhanced' badge on images. Sticky 'Add to Bag' CTA on mobile.

merchant.dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation. Clean white workspace (Solid surface, no glass here).
merchant.ai_catalog_engine: The 'Wow Moment'. Side-by-side or drag-slider comparison showing the Raw Photo vs AI Transformed Photo. Must use the media assets provided.
merchant.upload_zone: Large dashed border drag-and-drop zone with a warm gray background.

consumer_hero.description: Cinematic lifestyle fashion banner for consumer app

ai_before_raw.description: Raw unedited smartphone photo of garment

testing.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='login-button').

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react strictly. Do not use emoji icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive React web app. The platform has two halves: Consumer App and Merchant Dashboard.
For the Consumer App, use pure HTML/Tailwind styling for an immersive, layout-flexible design. Focus on large imagery, bento grids, and an 'Instagram boutique' visual feed for store listings.
For the Merchant Dashboard, use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Tables, Modals, Forms) but customize them to match the Organic & Earthy palette. No generic 'Vercel-look'.
Implement the 'AI Catalog Wow Moment' in the merchant dashboard utilizing the exact raw vs premium images provided in the media section to demonstrate the transformation.
Apply the data-testid attribute consistently across all interactive UI elements.
Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Embed and use Clash Display (Headings) and Satoshi (Body).
Do not invent new colors outside the defined palette. Never use purple or violet gradients.
